one_liner: Ecommerce platform for creators to sell digital products directly to fans.

auth.notes: Gumroad's API is OAuth2; a developer can also manually generate a long-lived personal access token for their own account without the full OAuth dance. Tokens do not expire until revoked.

access.notes: Any Gumroad account holder can create an OAuth application and get client_id/client_secret immediately from account settings, no review step found.

api.notes: API covers products, sales, subscribers, offer codes, licenses; base URL https://api.gumroad.com/v2/ per search summary.

verdict.rationale: Self-serve OAuth2 app creation with no approval gate and a documented REST API.
